questions.questionTextEn: A huge amount of sources found in the Vindhya rocks are of –
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P. Lower Sub. (Pre) 2004] A huge amount of sources found in the Vindhya rocks are of –
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) Limestone. The rocks of the vindhya range are actually sedimentary rocks which were formed by sedimentation of water suspended particles. questions.questionTextEn: Which one of the following rock systems in India is the main source of coal deposits?
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2008 ; U.P. U.D.A./L.D.A. (Pre) 2006] Which one of the following rock systems in India is the main source of coal deposits?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Gondwana system. The coal deposits in India are primarily concentrated in the Gondwana sediments occurring mainly in the eastern and central parts of Peninsular India, although Gondwana coal deposits also occur in Assam and Sikkim in North Eastern part of the country. According to data of IMYB 2021, more than about 99% coal (as on April 2021) deposites and production has been covered by Gondwana Coal. [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2008 ; U.P. U.D.A./L.D.A. (Pre) 2006]

questions.questionTextHi: [U.P. R.O./A.R.O. (Pre) (Re-Exam) 2016] Which of the following systems of rocks provides maximum amount of coal in India?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Gondwana System. The coal deposits in India are primarily concentrated in the Gondwana sediments occurring mainly in the eastern and central parts of Peninsular India, although Gondwana coal deposits also occur in Assam and Sikkim in North Eastern part of the country. According to data of IMYB 2021, more than about 99% coal (as on April 2021) deposites and production has been covered by Gondwana Coal. [U.P. R.O./A.R.O. (Pre) (Re-Exam) 2016]

[I.A.S. (Pre) 1993]
